title: COvid-19 statistics Ontology

description.en:
Semantic model for publishing COVID-19 data on the Web as a Graph. 
The ontology focuses to represent COVID-19 cases: Create a COVID-19 knowledge space (e.g.,new cases, total active, recovered, deceased, new deceased in a day) and provide the statistic of cases int Geo-location (district, state, country and continent) on daily basis.

keywords: Ontology Based Courtry Wise Covid-19 Statistics
